blocks.title: Arbitrary arguments
blocks.text: Jab arguments ki tadaad pehle se maloom na ho to *args kitne bhi positional arguments (aur **kwargs kitne bhi keyword arguments) jama karta hai.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
def add_numbers(*args):
....return sum(args)    # sum() adds the values

print(add_numbers(1, 2, 3))    # 6
print(add_numbers(4, 5))       # 9

blocks.prompt: Class activity: **kwargs aazmayein. def show(**kwargs): print(kwargs) show(a=1, b=2) ke liye kya print karega?
blocks.explanation: {'a': 1, 'b': 2}: **kwargs keyword arguments ko dictionary mein jama karta hai.

items: *args: kitne bhi positional arguments (tuple); **kwargs: kitne bhi keyword arguments (dictionary).
